data.name: Ruthless
data.description: Whenever you kill a foe or reduce it to a dying state with a melee attack, you can immediately make another attack with the same weapon on any legal target at the same attack bonus as a swift action. You gain a +%1 bonus on damage rolls with this attack.|LowTemplarLvl
